purpose: Research catalog and original motion-pattern notes for an Arguseye launch film; no full creator prompts or media are reproduced.

method.catalog: Decoded public Next.js flight payload cards array from the public homepage HTML.
method.verification: Matched every unique entry URL against the public XML sitemap and matched category counts against the homepage.
method.details: Read six shortlisted public entry pages through Jina Reader, with a concurrency limit of three.
method.interpretation: Most notes are original recommendations inferred from public titles and categories, not observed descriptions of the videos. Six notes additionally use detail-page text.
method.retention: Only factual metadata, source links and original notes are committed. Full fetched pages remain temporary; no full prompts, video files, avatar images or posters are copied into the research artifacts.
